# Check existing Venmo sent payment requests to Denise to avoid duplicates

from datetime import datetime

pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
amazon_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='amazon'][0]

# Resolve Denise email via phone contacts (exact first_name match)
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='5708520672', password=phone_pw)
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']
contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Denise', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    contacts.extend(res)
    if len(res) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

denise_contacts = [c for c in contacts if c.get('first_name','').lower() == 'denise']
assert len(denise_contacts) == 1
denise_email = denise_contacts[0]['email']

# Compute amount from amazon cart excluding tax & delivery
am_login = apis.amazon.login(username='normansmit@gmail.com', password=amazon_pw)
am_token = am_login['access_token']
cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=am_token)
amount = cart['base_cost'] - cart['discount'] + cart['gift_wrap_fee']

print('Denise email:', denise_email)
print('Computed amount (excluding tax & delivery):', amount)

# Login to venmo and fetch all sent payment requests (paginated)
ven_login = apis.venmo.login(username='normansmit@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
ven_token = ven_login['access_token']

all_reqs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=ven_token, query=denise_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    all_reqs.extend(res)
    if len(res) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('Total sent payment requests fetched:', len(all_reqs))

# Post-filter exact receiver email and amount
matching = []
for r in all_reqs:
    recv_email = r.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').lower()
    if recv_email == denise_email.lower() and abs(float(r.get('amount',0.0)) - float(amount)) < 1e-9:
